question: In July 2022, the Lok Sabha passed the Family Courts (Amendment) Bill, 2022, to overcome the issue of lack of jurisdiction of Family Courts in the States of Himachal Pradesh and ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nagaland**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In July 2022, the Lok Sabha passed the Family Courts (Amendment) Bill, 2022.
 
• This amendment was necessary to address the issue of lack of jurisdiction of Family Courts in the States of Himachal Pradesh and **Nagaland**.
